parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS, upright P waves and normal PR interval, normal R-wave progression, and isoelectric ST segments with upright T waves in all leads. The only ST change is slight concave J-point elevation in V2-V3, a normal variant. There is no convex ST elevation, reciprocal depression, or Q waves, so this does not meet STEMI criteria despite the team's impression.
